h_wording.H411: Toxic to aquatic life with long lasting effects

presence.note: A UVB and UVA filter the maker adds.

why_it_matters.text: Benzophenone-3, a filter for UVB and short-wave UVA with peaks near 288 and 325 nm. A hydrogen bond inside the molecule lets a proton hop across and back, shedding the absorbed energy as heat.

approval.product: OTC Monograph M020, Sunscreen Drug Products for Over-the-Counter Human Use
approval.basis: FDA OTC monograph. M020.10(l), "Oxybenzone up to 6 percent", in M020 as amended by Final Administrative Order OTC000039 (issued 2026-06-10, corrected 2026-08-10); the later order OTC000008-1 (Federal Register 2026-09-11) removed only aminobenzoic acid and trolamine salicylate. Checked 2026-11-15.

description: Benzophenone-3, a filter for UVB and short-wave UVA with peaks near 288 and 325 nm. A hydrogen bond inside the molecule lets a proton hop across and back, shedding the absorbed energy as heat.

parts.label: The ketone group
parts.sentence: A C=O with a carbon on each side. Its oxygen accepts hydrogen bonds but has no hydrogen to give, and it resists oxidation better than an aldehyde.

parts.label: The phenol group
parts.sentence: An O-H fixed directly to a benzene ring. The ring makes that hydrogen easier to give up than an ordinary alcohol's, which is why many phenols act as antioxidants.

parts.label: The ether oxygen
parts.sentence: An oxygen bridging two carbons, written C-O-C. It accepts hydrogen bonds but has no hydrogen to give, and it is slow to react.
